name: splash court: attract loop opens on a home half-court possession (no tip-off) and dwells 3s on the three real play cards
description: Two changes are verified. (1) NO TIP-OFF: SplashCourt now runs testGamePlayHome instead of testGamePlay. testGamePlay is also what the REAL game uses (App.jsx:376/914), so it could not be changed - useGame gained a sibling branch that shares the whole reset block but replaces triggerJumpBall with setupOffense('home'). INITIAL_PLAYERS gives nobody the ball and ensurePGHasBall() returns early when there is no carrier, so the branch also hands home PG (id 1) the ball or the possession would run ball-less. Checked by: no player ever enters the jumpball animation, home PG holds the ball on the first sample, and every one of the 10 players is in the right-hand half (gx >= 55) when the possession starts - INITIAL_PLAYERS sits at gx 34-53 around centre court, HOME_FORMATION at 62-84, so that threshold discriminates the two formations. (2) THE THREE CARDS DWELL: the play gate used to answer at GATE_MS=0 and PlayPickerOverlay was never mounted in the splash at all, so a dwell alone would have been a frozen court with nothing on it. The overlay is now rendered while playPickState is true, and PLAY_GATE_MS=3000 holds it. Checked by: the picker appears with all three real cards, its first contiguous appearance lasts ~3s, it is shifted up by PLAY_PICKER_DY so it does not bury the TAP TO PLAY CTA at y=304, its cards are pointer-events:none (App.jsx puts onClick=tryExpand on the whole inline container and PlayCard carries its own onClick, so an interactive card would resolve the play early on a tap meant to expand the post), and the possession still proceeds after the gate resolves. Runs in App Desktop/Mobile via App.jsx's DEV-only ?mode=inline override, because Post View is not a WebContentsView and the runner cannot attach to it.

The pre-existing query string is stashed in sessionStorage (survives same-tab navigation) so the final step can put it back - the sibling splash tests blank the whole search on cleanup, which silently strips the preview's own ?view=mobile.

Short settle only. The play gate opens ~1.4s after mount (setupOffense walks the formation in first), so the original 2500ms guaranteed the sampler armed AFTER the picker was already up - which timed only its tail (1898ms of a 3000ms dwell).
ATTRACT='static' has no sim, so every assertion below would be vacuous.

steps._comment: Page-side setInterval at 50ms rather than a runner while-loop: the 3s dwell has to be MEASURED, and per-iteration runner overhead would smear it. TWO trackers, because they answer different questions. Tracker A (pickerFirst/atPicker/geom) captures the FIRST sighting - that is the game-start possession, which is the only one whose formation reflects testGamePlayHome's setupOffense (later home possessions arrive via triggerThrowInHome, which parks the inbounder on the LEFT sideline at gx ~-1). Tracker B (winFirst/winLast) times a window whose ONSET was actually witnessed - it refuses to start until the picker has been seen ABSENT once. Timing tracker A instead is what produced the bogus 1898ms: the picker was already open when sampling began, so only its tail was measured. It also tracks maxBottom: the LOWEST edge the panel reaches on any frame, in parent coords with its own translate folded in. A single sighting is not enough here - cardAnim staggers the cards in from +22px below their resting spot, so the panel's worst frame is its first, not its settled one.
Wait for the play gate to open. setupOffense has to walk the formation into place first, so this is roughly a second in.
Taken while the picker is up - this is the frame the change is about: three cards over a right-half possession, CTA still readable below.

Either way the dwell is measured end to end. Generous max because a full home->away->home cycle can take tens of seconds.
Let the possession run on past the gate, so postAnims can prove the loop did not stall on the new start path.

(() => { const ids = ['probe-no-tipoff','probe-ball-home-pg','probe-right-half','probe-picker-cards','probe-picker-dwell','probe-picker-clears-cta','probe-picker-inert','probe-loop-runs']; ids.forEach(i => document.querySelectorAll('#' + i).forEach(n => n.remove())); const s = window.__s; const mk = id => { const d = document.createElement('div'); d.id = id; document.body.appendChild(d); }; const out = {}; out.jumpball = s.anims.jumpball || 0; if (!s.anims.jumpball) mk('probe-no-tipoff'); out.firstBall = s.firstBall; if (s.firstBall && s.firstBall.id === 'splash-player-1' && s.firstBall.team === 'home' && s.firstBall.role === 'PG') mk('probe-ball-home-pg'); const pos = s.atPicker || []; const leftOfHalf = pos.filter(p => p.gx === null || p.gx < 55); out.count = pos.length; out.leftOfHalf = leftOfHalf; if (pos.length === 10 && leftOfHalf.length === 0) mk('probe-right-half'); out.cards = s.cards; if (s.cards && s.cards.length === 3) mk('probe-picker-cards'); const dwell = Math.round(s.winLast - s.winFirst); out.dwellMs = dwell; out.firstSightingMs = Math.round(s.pickerLast - s.pickerFirst); out.firstSightingAtSample = s.firstAtSample; if (dwell >= 2500 && dwell <= 4000) mk('probe-picker-dwell'); out.geom = s.geom; out.maxBottom = s.maxBottom === null ? null : Math.round(s.maxBottom); out.maxBottomAtSample = s.maxBottomAtSample; if (s.maxBottom !== null && s.maxBottom <= 306) mk('probe-picker-clears-cta'); out.pointerEvents = s.pe; if (s.pe === 'none') mk('probe-picker-inert'); const act = Object.keys(s.postAnims || {}).filter(k => k !== 'idle'); out.postActions = act; if (act.length > 0) mk('probe-loop-runs'); return JSON.stringify(out); })()

steps._comment: ASSERTION 1: no player ever entered the jumpball animation. Under the old testGamePlay this fired on every restart, so this is the tip-off actually being skipped rather than merely fast.

ASSERTION 2: the very first carrier seen is splash-player-1, home PG. Catches the ball-less-possession trap - INITIAL_PLAYERS hands nobody the ball and ensurePGHasBall() returns early with no carrier, so if the new branch forgot the hasBall assignment the whole possession would run with no ball and this would find no carrier at all.

ASSERTION 3: all ten players are at gx >= 55 when the gate opens, i.e. a right-hand half-court set. INITIAL_PLAYERS is gx 34-53 (centre court, tip-off) and HOME_FORMATION is 62-84, so this distinguishes the two rather than just checking somebody moved.
ASSERTION 4: all three real cards (standard, pickroll, iso) are mounted - the shared PLAYS table from PlayPickerOverlay.jsx, not a splash-local copy.

ASSERTION 5: a picker window whose onset was witnessed lasted 2500-4000ms, i.e. PLAY_GATE_MS=3000 is in force. Fails at the old GATE_MS=0. Measured from tracker B, not the first sighting - the first sighting can start before sampling does, which is exactly how this assertion first reported a false 1898ms.

ASSERTION 6: the LOWEST edge the panel reaches on ANY sampled frame, in parent coords, stays at or above y=306 - just clear of the TAP TO PLAY CTA whose glyphs start at 304 (scale 2, 9-row monogram, so 304..322). Unshifted the overlay spans 232..348 and would bury the CTA for the whole 3s dwell. Measured as a max over the window rather than at one sighting because cardAnim's entrance drops the cards 22px below their resting spot: at PLAY_PICKER_DY=-56 the settled panel cleared the CTA but that entrance frame still clipped it.

ASSERTION 7: computed pointer-events on a play card is 'none'. App.jsx:613 puts onClick=tryExpand on the whole inline container and PlayCard carries its own onClick, so without this a tap meant to expand the post would also resolve the play early and desync the AUTO_PLAY rotation.

ASSERTION 8: at least one non-idle animation fired AFTER the gate resolved, so the possession actually continues. Guards against the new start path satisfying every static check while leaving the loop parked.
